correctness.rationale: PASS. For wheel W_{n+1}=K1∨C_n, 0<ε<1, c=1−ε, q=c², stationary off-diagonal two-point covariance is a unique q-contraction fixed point under independent synchronous updates. Rim symmetry reduces the equations to a two-step cyclic Green kernel G=(I−q(T²+2I+T^(−2))/9)^(−1), giving the exact H_n=(1−t^ell_n)/(n δ(1+t^ell_n)), ell_n=n/gcd(n,2), δ=√(1−4q/9), t<1/6. The elementary bound 2(n+1)t^ell_n<1 for n≥3 proves H_n>H_{n+1}; F_q derivative is positive since 1−α(1+4k)=3(1−q)(9+q)/((3−q)(9−4q))>0, so R_n=c F_q(H_n) decreases strictly. Expansion H_n=(nδ)^(−1)+O(t^(n/2)/n) yields the positive n² gap limit. Fresh exact rational off-diagonal pair solves at q=1/4 for n=3,4,5,6 gave hub/rim 2/29,313/5884,2654/60551,1283/34196, strictly falling; tests are finite corroboration only.
